faqs.q: What is Vision C?
faqs.a: Vision C is a mini-SCADA and data-logging application for Windows. It reads tags from PLCs and devices, shows live values and trends, stores history, records batches and generates reports. It supports up to 100 tags.

faqs.q: Which protocols does Vision C support?
faqs.a: Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, BCD and AIBUS, across multiple ports.

faqs.q: Can Vision C send data to the cloud?
faqs.a: Yes. A one-click connection forwards data to Vision Web, Dicot's hosted SCADA platform, for remote monitoring and alerts.

faqs.q: How is Vision C licensed?
faqs.a: As a time-based licence of 2, 5, 10 or 20 years, or perpetual without future updates. Pricing is provided by authorised dealers.

faqs.q: Do I need a developer to set it up?
faqs.a: No. Configuration is done through the application. Most customers are logging data on the first day.

products.name: Vision Web
products.tagline: Your plant on any screen, with alarms where your team already is.
products.summary: Vision Web is Dicot's hosted cloud SCADA platform. It brings up to 20,000 tags per project into a browser, updates at 50–100 ms, keeps two years of history and sends alarms by SMS, email, WhatsApp and Telegram. Dicot hosts and maintains the platform; you log in and run the plant.
products.metaDescription: Vision Web is a hosted cloud SCADA platform with up to 20,000 tags, 50–100 ms updates, two-year history and SMS, email, WhatsApp and Telegram alarms.
products.bestFor: Teams that need remote monitoring, multi-site visibility and mobile alarms without running servers or a VPN.

faqs.q: Is Vision Web hosted by Dicot?
faqs.a: Yes. Dicot hosts, maintains and backs up Vision Web. Customers do not need to provision cloud infrastructure or manage servers.

faqs.q: How fast does Vision Web update?
faqs.a: Typical latency is 50–100 ms on a stable connection.

faqs.q: How long is data retained?
faqs.a: Two years of historical data is retained in the platform's NoSQL store.

faqs.q: Which alarm channels are supported?
faqs.a: SMS, email, WhatsApp and Telegram, with different triggers and recipients per alarm.

faqs.q: Can I connect an existing PLC or Vision C installation?
faqs.a: Yes. Vision Web receives data over MQTT or HTTP, and Vision C can forward data with a one-click connection.

faqs.q: How is Vision Web priced?
faqs.a: As a yearly subscription by tag count, with add-ons for extra users, SMS and WhatsApp. Prices are shared through authorised dealers.

products.name: Vision S

products.bestFor: Pharma, process and large manufacturing sites that need audit trails, high tag counts and a configurable SCADA architecture.

faqs.q: What is Vision S?
faqs.a: Vision S is an enterprise SCADA platform for Windows. It collects data from PLCs and devices, provides operator screens, alarms, trends, reports, recipes and batch recording, and scales to 60,000 tags.

faqs.q: Does Vision S support 21 CFR Part 11 requirements?
faqs.a: Vision S provides 21 CFR-ready audit trails, electronic signatures and user-level access control. Validation and compliance remain the responsibility of the regulated site.

faqs.q: Which protocols are supported?
faqs.a: More than 4,000 drivers, including OPC UA and OPC DA, with multi-port connectivity.

faqs.q: Can I develop and deploy with different licences?
faqs.a: Yes. Development, runtime, client-server and web-client licences are separate, and can be combined.

faqs.q: Where is historical data stored?
faqs.a: In PostgreSQL, with options for third-party integration.

faqs.q: What is Vision S Lite?
faqs.a: Vision S Lite is a lighter edition of Vision S, in development at Dicot. It keeps the Vision S software approach but uses a reduced protocol set and a smaller design library for cost-sensitive applications.

faqs.q: How is Vision S Lite different from Vision S?
faqs.a: Vision S Lite is scoped below Vision S: fewer protocols and a smaller design library. Vision S remains the choice for 60,000-tag, multi-line plants that need the full 4,000+ protocol library, OPC UA/DA and 21 CFR-ready audit trails.

faqs.q: What does Dicot Innovations do?
faqs.a: Dicot builds SCADA, IIoT and data-acquisition software for manufacturers. Its products are Vision C (mini-SCADA and data logger), Vision S (enterprise SCADA), Vision Web (hosted cloud SCADA) and VGraphic (cloud report generator). Vision S Lite, a lighter Vision S for cost-sensitive applications, is in development. The company was founded in Ahmedabad in 2022 and its software is deployed in more than 1,000 plants.

faqs.q: Is Dicot's SCADA software made in India?
faqs.a: Yes. Dicot designs and develops its software in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. It is recognised under Startup India, incubated at i-Hub (a Gujarat Government enterprise), supported by the Wadhwani Foundation and part of the Make in India initiative.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Vision C, Vision S and Vision Web?
faqs.a: Vision C is a lightweight on-premises mini-SCADA for up to 100 tags. Vision S is an enterprise SCADA for up to 60,000 tags, with 4,000+ protocols and 21 CFR-ready audit trails. Vision Web is a cloud SCADA platform hosted by Dicot, with up to 20,000 tags per project and mobile alarms. Vision S Lite, in development, is a lighter Vision S with fewer protocols and a smaller design library for cost-sensitive applications.

faqs.q: Can Dicot software connect to existing PLCs and machines?
faqs.a: Yes. Vision C supports Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD and AIBUS. Vision S supports more than 4,000 device protocols including OPC UA and OPC DA. Vision Web receives data over MQTT and HTTP, including from Vision C.

faqs.q: How do I get pricing?
faqs.a: Dicot sells through an authorised dealer network, so prices are shared by your nearest dealer rather than published online. Send an enquiry with your tag count and deployment type and the team will route it to the right partner.

faqs.q: Which industries use Dicot software?
faqs.a: Pharmaceuticals, textiles, food and beverage, machine tools, water treatment, foundry, ceramics, railway, HVAC, chemicals, oil and gas and packaging. Deployments range from a single machine to multi-line plants.
